title: ‘Cognitive impairment’ hinders Rodrigo Duterte’s ability to join ICC proceedings, defense tells court ahead of trial

blocks.text: Former President Rodrigo Duterte’s ability to participate in his trial for crimes against humanity before the ICC are “extremely limited” due to “cognitive impairment,” his defense team told the tribunal on Wednesday, less than a week before the expected opening of the proceedings.
